guide.summary: State and civic museums, churches, gardens and a food hall, with trattorie, dinners, breakfast cafés, pastry, gelato and cocktail bars, each checked against its own website.
highlights: Basilica di San Miniato al Monte
guide.tip: The Uffizi, Pitti, Bargello, Cappelle Medicee and Orsanmichele all close on Mondays, Palazzo Medici Riccardi closes on Wednesdays and Osteria Santo Spirito on Tuesdays, so check each closing day before you fix your plan.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Uffizi, Palazzo Pitti, the Bargello, the Cappelle Medicee and Orsanmichele close on Mondays, and the Boboli Gardens close on the first and last Monday of each month. Palazzo Medici Riccardi closes on Wednesdays, Museo Novecento on Thursdays and Harry's Bar Firenze on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: The Cappelle Medicee charge €11, with an optional €4 reservation, and the Boboli + Bardini combined ticket is sold only at the ticket offices on the day you visit. Buca Mario, Il Latini, Osteria Santo Spirito, Ora d'Aria and B-Roof all take table bookings online.

toolkit.label: Strike on 30 October
toolkit.copy: The Uffizi Galleries' strike notice warns of a national general strike on 30 October 2026 and says closures and disruptions may occur. It guarantees only the Uffizi, from 1.30 pm to 6.30 pm, and the Boboli Gardens, open all day.

toolkit.label: Rules and age limits
toolkit.copy: Michelangelo's Secret Room at the Cappelle Medicee is by reservation only, lasts 15 minutes, and does not admit children under 10 or unaccompanied minors. Museo Novecento's permanent collection is closed for renovation, so only its temporary exhibitions are on show.

guide.dek: Plan the state museums around Monday closures, check the 30 October strike notice, and book dinners such as Buca Mario or Il Latini online.
intro: You can build a Florence visit around places whose own websites show current activity. The Uffizi Gallery, at Piazzale degli Uffizi 6, opens Tuesday to Sunday from 8.15 am to 6.30 pm, and its ticket office closes at 5.30 pm. The Uffizi Galleries' strike notice warns of a national general strike on 30 October 2026 and guarantees only the Uffizi, from 1.30 pm, and the Boboli Gardens, all day. Palazzo Pitti keeps the same Tuesday-to-Sunday hours, and its Museum of Costume and Fashion shows "Sarmi's Genius" until 31 December 2026.

The Bargello, at Via del Proconsolo 4, and the Cappelle Medicee, at Piazza di Madonna degli Aldobrandini 6, open Tuesday to Sunday from 8.15 am to 6.50 pm and close on Mondays. Both list a special evening opening on 30 November 2026, and the Bargello and Orsanmichele add one on 26 October. Palazzo Strozzi shows "Broken: The Power of the Fragment" until 24 January 2027. Palazzo Medici Riccardi, open from 9 am to 7 pm and closed on Wednesdays, runs "Oltre il Rinascimento" until 5 January 2027. Museo Novecento has two exhibitions, but its permanent collection is closed for renovation.

Santa Croce closes early, at 4.00 pm, on Friday 23 October. San Miniato al Monte, at Via delle Porte Sante 34, presents a new bronze sculpture on 24 October 2026 and holds liturgies for its patron saint that weekend. Santa Maria Novella posts early closings on its own site. The Boboli Gardens close at 4:30 pm from November, and the Villa Bardini ticket desk on Costa San Giorgio is open every day from 10:30 am to 6 pm. If you have children with you, Museo Galileo runs tours with costumed actors on 24 and 31 October, and Palazzo Strozzi runs family activities into January.

For food, Mercato Centrale is open every day from 9:00 to 23:00, and La Ménagère on Via de' Ginori is open every day from 8.00 to 2.00. Procacci on Via de' Tornabuoni opens Monday to Saturday from 10.00 to 21.00 and has published a 2026 menu. For dinner, Buca Mario serves Monday to Saturday from 19:00, Il Latini's kitchen opens for dinner from Tuesday and adds lunch at weekends, and Osteria Santo Spirito closes on Tuesdays. Harry's Bar Firenze on Via il Prato closes on Mondays, and B-Roof, on the fifth floor of the Grand Hotel Baglioni, takes bookings for its American Bar.
summaryCards: Pair the Uffizi Gallery, open Tuesday to Sunday from 8.15 am, with lunch at Mercato Centrale, which is open daily from 9:00.
Start with breakfast at La Ménagère, which opens at 8.00, then walk up to the Boboli Gardens or the Villa Bardini, whose ticket desk opens at 10:30 am.
Avoid Mondays for the Uffizi, Pitti, Bargello and Cappelle Medicee, and read the Uffizi Galleries' strike notice for 30 October 2026.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The Duomo, Museo Ferragamo and several hotel bar sites (Four Seasons, Lungarno Collection, Rocco Forte) returned HTTP 403; the City of Florence, Musei Civici Fiorentini and regional museums (Museo di San Marco) sites refused connections; and the Galleria dell'Accademia, Caffè Gilli, Trattoria Mario, St. Regis, Gelateria Santa Trinita, Badiani and Paszkowski sites had certificate or SSL errors. None of these failures is evidence of closure. Several food entries are confirmed only at medium confidence, from a live booking system, published hours or a 2026 copyright line: Harry's Bar Firenze, Osteria Santo Spirito and Ora d'Aria showed no 2026-dated content, and Vivoli, Ditta Artigianale, Pasticceria Buonamici, B-Roof, Trattoria Zà Zà and Enoteca Pinchiorri publish no opening hours. Santa Croce, Santa Maria Novella, San Miniato al Monte and Museo Galileo regular hours were not readable. Palazzo Pitti, the Boboli Gardens and Orsanmichele have no street number. Museo Novecento and Harry's Bar pages contradict themselves on opening days. The strike notice is attributed only to the Uffizi Galleries' notice page; the Pitti and Boboli pages carry only its headline.
